user.title: Connect this Home Assistant to Simson
user.description: Keep the default when the Simson add-on runs on this Home Assistant. Enter a different local API URL only when the add-on is hosted elsewhere on your network.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Simson add-on. Check that it is running, then confirm the local API URL.

abort.already_configured: This Home Assistant is already connected to Simson.
abort.addon_not_ready: The Simson add-on is still starting. Wait a moment, then try again.
